question: The Financial Literacy Week is an initiative by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Financial Literacy Week is an initiative of RBI to promote awareness on various key topics every year through a focused campaign.
 
• Financial Literacy Week 2019 was observed from June 3-7 on the theme of “Farmers” and how they benefit by being a part of the formal banking system.
 
• To build awareness and disseminate financial literacy messages to the farming community,
 
• It focused content in the form of posters and leaflets has been prepared for dissemination.
 
• Banks have been advised to display the posters and content in their rural bank branches, Financial Literacy Centers, ATMs and websites.
 
• RBI undertook a centralized mass media campaign during the month of June on Doordarshan and All India Radio to disseminate essential financial awareness messages to farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Reserve Bank of India**

 
 
• ​The RBI is the central bank of India, established in 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
 
• It regulates and controls the monetary policy of the country, ensuring financial stability and managing inflation.
 
• The RBI manages India’s monetary policy by setting key interest rates
 
 
• like the **Repo Rate** and **Reverse Repo Rate** to control inflation and stabilize the economy
 
 
 
• The RBI is responsible for issuing and managing the currency in India.
 
 
 
• **Punjab National Bank (PNB)**
 
 
• **​**PNB is one of India’s oldest and largest nationalized banks. 
 
• It was founded in Lahore (now in Pakistan) and is known for serving millions of customers across various sectors.
 
• After its merger with Oriental Bank of Commerce and United Bank of India in 2020,
 
 
• PNB became the second-largest public sector bank in India, in terms of business and branch network.
 
 
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)**
 
 
• **​**SBI is India’s largest public sector bank in terms of assets, deposits, branches, and employees.
 
• It was founded as the Bank of Calcutta in 1806, later becoming SBI in 1955.
 
• SBI has a significant international footprint, with branches and offices in over 30 countries
